collection.description: Whenever a father picks up his baby, the child fusses and reaches for another caregiver.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Whenever (name1), a father, picks up his baby, the child fusses and reaches for another caregiver. He knows infants have preferences, but the rejection still stings.
